t: 英国向西班牙宣战，这意味着西班牙进入七年战争。
te: Great Britain declares war on Spain, which meant the entry of Spain into the Seven Years' War.
dz: 英国向西班牙宣战，这意味着西班牙进入七年战争。
de: Great Britain declares war on Spain, which meant the entry of Spain into the Seven Years' War.

t: 法国人胡盖诺特·让·卡拉斯因杀害儿子被错误定罪而死后被当局施以酷刑;这一事件激励了伏尔泰开始宗…
te: French Huguenot Jean Calas, who had been wrongly convicted of killing his son, dies after being tortured by authorities…
dz: 法国人胡盖诺特·让·卡拉斯因杀害儿子被错误定罪而死后被当局施以酷刑;这一事件激励了伏尔泰开始宗教宽容和法律改革运动.
de: French Huguenot Jean Calas, who had been wrongly convicted of killing his son, dies after being tortured by authorities; the event inspired Voltaire to begin a campaign for religious tolerance and legal reform.

t: 俄罗斯和普鲁士签署"圣彼得堡条约".
te: Russia and Prussia sign the Treaty of St. Petersburg.
dz: 俄罗斯和普鲁士签署"圣彼得堡条约".
de: Russia and Prussia sign the Treaty of St. Petersburg.

t: 特雷维喷泉正式完工并在罗马落成.
te: Trevi Fountain is officially completed and inaugurated in Rome.
dz: 特雷维喷泉正式完工并在罗马落成.
de: Trevi Fountain is officially completed and inaugurated in Rome.

t: 瑞典和普鲁士签署"汉堡条约".
te: Sweden and Prussia sign the Treaty of Hamburg.
dz: 瑞典和普鲁士签署"汉堡条约".
de: Sweden and Prussia sign the Treaty of Hamburg.

t: 英军开始围攻哈瓦那并暂时占领这座城市。
te: British forces begin the Siege of Havana and temporarily capture the city.
dz: 七年战争：英军开始围攻哈瓦那并暂时占领这座城市。
de: Seven Years' War: British forces begin the Siege of Havana and temporarily capture the city.

t: 威廉斯塔尔战役(Battle of Wilhelmsthal):不伦瑞克费迪南德的英国-汉诺威…
te: The British-Hanoverian army of Ferdinand of Brunswick defeats French forces in Westphalia.
dz: 威廉斯塔尔战役(Battle of Wilhelmsthal):不伦瑞克费迪南德的英国-汉诺威军队在威斯特伐利亚击败了法国军队.
de: Battle of Wilhelmsthal: The British-Hanoverian army of Ferdinand of Brunswick defeats French forces in Westphalia.

t: 凯瑟琳大帝在反对她丈夫彼得三世的政变后成为了俄罗斯皇后.
te: Catherine the Great becomes Empress of Russia following the coup against her husband, Peter III.
dz: 凯瑟琳大帝在反对她丈夫彼得三世的政变后成为了俄罗斯皇后.
de: Catherine the Great becomes Empress of Russia following the coup against her husband, Peter III.

t: 俄罗斯前皇帝彼得三世被谋杀.
te: Former emperor Peter III of Russia is murdered.
dz: 俄罗斯前皇帝彼得三世被谋杀.
de: Former emperor Peter III of Russia is murdered.
Seven Years' War: Battle of Signal Hill.

t: 英国从西班牙夺取并占领马尼拉。
te: The British capture Manila from Spain and occupy it.
dz: 七年战争：英国从西班牙夺取并占领马尼拉。
de: Seven Years' War: The British capture Manila from Spain and occupy it.
